objective: Compare r620 and r631 request-level E2E latency and throughput with identical prompts and 64-token outputs.

checklist.requirement: Freeze a request-level design that does not use decode-step metrics as an E2E proxy.
Both sources use the same 12-case w2_long_reuse matrix, retain --profile, and omit 8-token-only flags.
Execute the frozen r620 baseline source and r631 candidate source.

checklist.evidence: Both attempt roots contain 12 case directories, 12 logs, 12 guards, RUN_COMPLETE, and DOWNLOADED receipts.
checklist.requirement: Complete warmup r0 and measured r0-r4 for recompute and exact_restore.

checklist.evidence: All 80 measured rows have generated_tokens=64, 64 output_token_ids, and 63 decode_step_ns values.
checklist.requirement: Use identical canonical 64-token output length with four requests per case.

checklist.evidence: 48/48 warmup-plus-measured request pairs and 40/40 measured request pairs match token-for-token.
checklist.requirement: Preserve output-token parity as a hard gate.

checklist.evidence: comparison.json includes case makespan, request throughput, output-token throughput, request E2E, TTFT, and decode latency for both policies.
checklist.requirement: Report request-level latency and throughput rather than only decode-step timing.

checklist.evidence: Recompute throughput +9.6366%; exact-restore throughput -2.5490%; pooled request E2E +4.4865% and +2.5943% respectively.
checklist.requirement: Quantify whether complete request E2E improves and by how much.

checklist.evidence: baseline_canonical_aggregate.json and candidate_canonical_aggregate.json reproduce makespan, TTFT, and decode medians.
checklist.requirement: Independently cross-check the new comparison aggregation.

checklist.evidence: Each attempt has 12 READY guards on GPUs 2,4,5,6; minimum free bytes exceed 25 GiB and maximum utilization is 0%.
checklist.requirement: Respect the fixed shared/non-exclusive GPU admission policy.

checklist.evidence: Both receipts record cleanup CLEAN; three ancestry-aware exact-tag scans report zero processes for both tags.
checklist.requirement: Clean up only exact-tag descendants and leave no tagged processes.

checklist.evidence: python3 -m pytest: 13 passed; py_compile PASS; all final JSON files parse.
checklist.requirement: Validate the runner, comparison, and final artifacts.

proof_boundary: This is a shared, non-exclusive TP4 run with five measured repetitions per policy. It proves the controlled w2_long_reuse request-level result, not universal production throughput.
